review: 712.8c-1: the countered Generous Soul's destination was missing, though its own replacement exiles it; the base expected now says it is exiled, and the comber variant names the Aura's attachment and token.
712.11d-1: the five-lands variant flipped only affordability, not whether a front-face cast-transformed ability is considered; replaced it with a double-faced card lacking such an ability.

712.14-1: the Grizzly Bears variant changed nothing the rule decides; rebuilt it on one Biolume Egg returned either by Zombify (front face up) or by its own delayed trigger (transformed), and folded 712.14a in.
712.14a-1: dropped; its Terror variant only stopped the sacrifice trigger, so it was no minimal pair for entering transformed. 712.14a is now covered by 712.14-1.

712.15a-1: both variants ended with Delver front face up, so nothing flipped; the pair is now Moonmist before versus after turning the manifest face up, which flips Delver versus Insectile Aberration.
712.18-1: the base variant carried a non-empty delta, against the schema; Moonmist moved into decisions and the Cloudshift variant names its change against it.

712.21-1: Blood Artist's target and the may-choices were not fixed in decisions; fixed. Dropped 712.21e from its rules, since triggers are 712.21's own example and no effect here counts objects or cards; 712.21e has its own scenario now.

712.21d-2: the base variant had a non-empty delta, and the Wheel-on-B variant gave the same outcome as the base, so nothing flipped; rebuilt with Damnation on B's turn so the contrast is melded (one choice moves both cards) against two separate creatures (one card exiled, the other to the library).
712.21e-1: added; 712.21e was listed on 712.21-1, where nothing counts objects or cards that moved. Fumigate's life gain counts the melded permanent as one creature against two when unmelded.

712.10: the skip reason was false (The Golden-Gear Colossus transforms any double-faced artifact you control, and Mycosynth Lattice makes a Siege with a sorcery back face one); added 712.10-1 and removed the skip.
712.14b: the skip reason was false (a flicker effect such as Ghostly Flicker returns the card that left without selecting by type); added 712.14b-1 and removed the skip.
712.13a: the skip reason claimed daybound was the only route and missed the rule's own Mystic Reflection construction; reworded to name that construction and why it is not built.

skipped.reason: the only construction is the rule's own example: Mycosynth Lattice plus March of the Machines to make a Siege spell a creature as it enters, Mystic Reflection copying a non-double-faced copy of a daybound creature at night, and a Siege with a sorcery back face. Lattice plus March also turns every land into a 0/0 creature that dies, and the outcome hinges on Forge applying daybound's enters-transformed rule to a battle entering as a copy, which is unverified; no daybound double-faced card has an instant or sorcery back face

Neither Graf Rats nor Midnight Scavengers is on the battlefield as a separate permanent. Chittering Host's enters trigger resolves with no other creature to affect.

scenarios.title: An instruction to transform a meld card is ignored

scenarios.title: A double-faced card in the graveyard has only its front face's characteristics

variants.expected: Valki, God of Lies is a legendary 2/1 black God creature with mana value 2. It is not a planeswalker and has no loyalty counters. Its enters trigger resolves with B's hand empty, exiling nothing.

scenarios.title: A melded permanent has the combined back face's characteristics and the sum of the front faces' mana values; a copy has mana value 0

decisions: B casts Fatal Push targeting Chittering Host, tapping the Swamp.

scenarios.title: Only a double-faced card or token can transform; a copy of one cannot
decisions: A casts Moonmist, tapping both Forests.

variants.label: double_faced_card
variants.expected: Hanweir Watchkeep transforms and is Bane of Hanweir, a red 5/5 Werewolf.

decisions: A considers casting Valki, God of Lies from hand as its front face, then as its back face, Tibalt, Cosmic Impostor.

scenarios.title: A double-faced card put onto the battlefield enters front face up unless the effect says transformed

decisions: A casts Zombify targeting Biolume Egg in A's graveyard, tapping all four Swamps.
Both players pass; Zombify resolves.
If Biolume Egg's enters trigger fires, A scries 2 and keeps both cards on top.
The turn moves to the end step; the delayed trigger resolves.

variants.label: zombify
variants.expected: Biolume Egg enters the battlefield front face up as a blue 0/4 Serpent Egg with defender, and its enters trigger fires (A scries 2). At the end step the delayed trigger does nothing, because the card it refers to left the graveyard; Biolume Egg stays front face up.

variants.label: delayed_trigger_returns_it
variants.delta: A does not cast Zombify.
variants.expected: At the beginning of the end step Biolume Egg returns to the battlefield transformed, back face up as Biolume Serpent, a blue 4/4 Serpent. No enters trigger fires and A does not scry.

scenarios.forge_notes: No Forge effect puts a card that is not double-faced onto the battlefield transformed (every such effect uses the card itself), so the second sentence of 712.14a cannot be shown.

scenarios.title: A face-down double-faced permanent does not transform, and turned face up it has its front face up

A casts Moonmist, tapping both Forests, and both players pass; Moonmist resolves.

variants.expected: While Moonmist resolves the face-down 2/2 does not transform. When turned face up it is Delver of Secrets with its front face up, a blue 1/1 Human Wizard, not Insectile Aberration.

scenarios.title: An 'as this permanent transforms' ability applies while the permanent transforms

setup.notes: It is night. Leeching Lurker is on the battlefield with its back face up; its front face is Curse of Leeches. B cast two spells during B's previous turn, and the day/night check happens as A's turn begins.

As it transforms, A chooses B as the player to attach the Curse to.

variants.expected: It is day. Curse of Leeches is on the battlefield attached to B, and stays there; it is not put into the graveyard for being an unattached Aura. It will drain B at B's next upkeep.

scenarios.title: A melded permanent leaving the battlefield is one permanent leaving and two cards moving

decisions: B casts Terror targeting Chittering Host, tapping both Swamps.
Both players pass; Terror resolves and Chittering Host is destroyed.
A's triggered abilities resolve; Blood Artist's targets B, and A puts a quest counter on Quest for Ancient Secrets for each of its triggers.

variants.label: melded_permanent
variants.expected: Graf Rats and Midnight Scavengers are both in A's graveyard. Blood Artist triggers once, as one creature died: B loses 1 life and A gains 1. Quest for Ancient Secrets triggers twice, as two cards were put into the graveyard, and gets 2 quest counters.

scenarios.title: An effect counting objects that changed zones counts a melded permanent once

decisions: A casts Ghostly Flicker targeting Agadeem, the Undercrypt and Grizzly Bears, tapping the three Islands.
Both players pass; Ghostly Flicker resolves, exiling both and returning those cards to the battlefield.

variants.label: sorcery_front
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears returns to the battlefield. Agadeem's Awakening stays in exile: in exile it is a sorcery card (its front face), so it cannot be put onto the battlefield.

variants.label: land_front
variants.delta: A's land is Brightclimb Pathway played as its back face, Grimclimb Pathway, instead of Agadeem's Awakening.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears and the Pathway both return to the battlefield; the Pathway returns front face up as Brightclimb Pathway.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's ChangeZone from exile to the battlefield may not refuse a non-permanent front face; confirm Agadeem's Awakening stays in exile.
